parallel_tracks: Ofcom Spring 2026 current coverage and V2 archive controls
Ofcom checker and methodology missingness guards
HMLR freehold polygon and CRS controls

sources.name: Connected Nations update: Spring 2026
sources.verified_facts: January 2026 snapshot; 24.9m residential premises with full fibre; 89% gigabit-capable; 39,000 premises unable to access decent fixed/FWA broadband
sources.limitations: Aggregate/postcode evidence is not exact project parcel identity or live orderability

sources.name: About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)
sources.verified_facts: 52 fixed and 18 FWA providers; AddressBase Epoch 123; 121 all-premises postcode files renamed r2; 1,741,096 documented rows
sources.limitations: Archive endpoint and MIME verified, but ZIP bytes, SHA-256, extracted inventory and physical row counts remain unavailable

sources.name: Connected Nations FAQs
sources.verified_facts: Fixed coverage downloads provide maximum available speeds; post-2024 fixed performance is not published at postcode level
sources.limitations: FAQ explains publication scope and cannot itself create parcel rows

sources.name: About the broadband checker
sources.verified_facts: Uses Ordnance Survey property base updated twice yearly; smaller networks may be missing; checker availability can differ from provider orderability; outages require provider status
sources.limitations: Missing checker result is not proof of no service and positive result is not live-order guarantee

sources.name: National Rolling Open Market Review May 2026 Request For Information
sources.verified_facts: Four-monthly January/May/September supplier cycle; UPRN-level assessment; AddressBase Premium Epoch 123 premise base; current and planned coverage separated; RFS means orderable within industry-standard timescales without excess construction charges except private-land causes
sources.limitations: Supplier submissions and restricted premise lists are not fully public raw product data

sources.name: Closure of the May 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review
sources.verified_facts: Evaluation is underway; postcode and UPRN outputs are to be published after assessment; next NR OMR planned for September 2026
sources.limitations: No final May 2026 UPRN result rows available from this page

sources.name: UPRN level release user guide and technical note for premises in BDUK plans
sources.verified_facts: UPRN-level current_gigabit and future_gigabit roles; AddressBase-derived postal premises; intervention overlaps and data lags explicitly documented
sources.limitations: BDUK view can lag recent delivery and differs from Ofcom premise base and methodology

sources.name: OS Open Linked Identifiers
sources.verified_facts: Open CSV lookup linking UPRNs, USRNs and TOIDs using authoritative relationships and OS spatial matching
sources.limitations: Identifier relationship does not prove project parcel ownership or broadband availability

sources.name: OS Open TOID
sources.verified_facts: Persistent identifiers for OS MasterMap topographic features; CSV and GeoPackage; identifier is not reused
sources.limitations: Generalised feature location and TOID identity still require measured parcel matching

sources.name: OS Open UPRN
sources.verified_facts: Coordinates for UPRNs across Great Britain; approximately 40 million addressable locations; CSV and GeoPackage
sources.limitations: UPRN point is not necessarily one-to-one with a land parcel and contains non-property addressable features

sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons spatial data
sources.verified_facts: Open Government Licence; freehold registered property subset; local-authority files; boundary polygons may appear in multiple files
sources.limitations: Leaseholds absent; indicative extent; duplicates at local-authority boundaries; not a complete project parcel inventory

sources.name: Identifying property and street information
sources.verified_facts: Government standard directs use of UPRN and USRN to identify property and street locations
sources.limitations: Standard defines identifiers but supplies no broadband or parcel-binding rows

sources.name: AddressBase Premium
sources.verified_facts: Around 40 million addresses and 100 million cross-references with address lifecycle and UPRNs
sources.limitations: Licensed product; full raw data not available in this environment and cannot be substituted with open UPRN alone
